==Wiki Sysops==

Many will think that the Wiki sysop has great powers, but the reality of wiki sysops power only allows them to protect pages from ''vandalism'', <u>delete</u> unwanted pages, and '''block''' a user's IP when they feel the the guidelines have not been adhered to.
